description: An unrolled parchment scroll: a rolled curl at the upper left, a tall rectangular sheet with two horizontal text lines, and a second rolled curl wrapping the bottom and extending right.
A small round ball at the lower left with a large swept wing of three feathers extending up and to the right behind it, as if flying to the left.
A Y-shaped slingshot standing upright: a straight handle at the bottom splitting into two arms that curve up and out, with a sagging band stretched between their tips.
A hedgehog head in profile facing left with long swept-back quills spiking to the right, a large eye, a pointed nose and a smiling muzzle; dense and hard to read.
A hedgehog head facing left in three-quarter view with a pointed ear, spiky quills fanning back to the right, a large oval eye, a round nose and a wide grin.
A hero's bust from the front: a smooth full-head mask with two large pointed eye lenses, and sloping shoulders with a V-shaped neckline.
A bold outlined capital letter F with its bottom edge cut on a slant so the stem ends lower on the left, drawn as a single closed outline.
